Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects solid parity, stock simulation, and the hidden-rest check that blocks posting.

The new tests cover the reported thread and neck defects. The negative tests still reject a pass that stops inside the neck. No goldens moved. No UI files changed.

Results locally, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `7173bb44ac16512c1571fc58b804816e98712e68`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-sim` unit tests: 195 passed.
- `hidden_rest_banded`: 5 passed, 1 ignored.
- `scan_arc`: 2 passed.
- `turned_hidden_rest`: 6 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test turning_hidden_floor`: 7 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-sim --test stock_sdf --test stock_columns --test field_floor`: PASS. Respectively, 9, 3, and 12 tests passed.
- These suites check stock-field consumers of the shared parity code. The diff changes no fixture, golden, or importer file. The extra importer rules select no tests.

Mutations repeated by the reviewer on `thread_valleys_and_neck_step_at_window_edge_are_not_false_rest`:

1. Restore `solid_rest.rs` from upstream/main: RED, `rest 0.8218199909993696 > gate 0.05625`. Restore the PR file: GREEN.
2. Restore `scan_turned.rs` and `scan_hidden.rs` from upstream/main: RED, `rest 2.373499756758999 > gate 0.05625`. Restore the PR files: GREEN.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/sim/src/solid_rest.rs:118` and the PR body, Tests / Not exercised: run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Record their results in the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, Testing / Heavy lanes at review, requires this evidence before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects the motion and app heavy lanes because both depend on sim. The body records only quick and clippy results and says that heavy lanes did not run. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Resolve any failures before readiness.

Heavy lanes: motion and app are reached. They were not run in this review, and the PR supplies no results. This is a validation blocker, not a reported failure of those tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Run the reached heavy lanes and record the results in the PR body.

- Motion and app heavy lanes passed on the final head: 220 steps, 0 failed. Three declared known-fail tests for #1950 failed as expected.
- The run exposed an invalid convex-cap warning expectation. `finish3d::overhang_entries_are_refused_without_false_hidden_rest` now pins one interval at four meridians, judged rest within tolerance, and no false warning. The gouge and refused-plunge checks remain.
- Mutation check: upstream `solid_rest.rs` makes the new pin RED. Restoring the PR file makes it GREEN.
- The true hidden-rest control, `stock_sim::hidden_rest_surfaces_under_a_ceiling`, passed.
- Quick gate passed: 7 steps, 0 failed. Clippy passed for motion, sim, and app with all targets and `-D warnings`.
- The PR body records these results and the remaining checks not run. No production code or golden files changed in this revision.

New head: `d19a630355c0d30d1780a66c6283a3ced77f9c02`.

Please re-review this head.

The maintainer ordered a clear-out of the PRs with `needs-rework` or `conflicts`: each one is repaired, reviewed and merged. This PR had a push in the last 6 hours, so the coordinator session of NeoTech does not edit its branch now. Push a refresh, or say here that you keep it. After 6 hours without a push or an answer, our session takes the PR over on this branch (a merge of `main`, never a rebase or a force-push) and repairs the open review items.

Addressed: I completed the requested motion and app heavy validation on local head `4d70ed516be254570af797f75bdfdd0da2d53cbf`.

- Heavy passed: 220 steps, 0 failed. The three declared #1950 failures occurred as expected.
- The run exposed a stale convex-sphere warning assertion. The local test correction pins `finish3d::convex_overhang_reports_refused_entries_without_false_rest`.
- Mutation: upstream parity gives 19.9783 mm of false hidden rest and makes this pin RED. Restoring the PR parity makes it GREEN.
- The full `finish3d` heavy suite passed: 33 tests. Quick passed: 7 steps. Clippy passed for motion, sim, and app with all targets and `-D warnings`.

Before my push, another session advanced the PR to `d19a630355c0d30d1780a66c6283a3ced77f9c02` and updated the PR body. I stopped publication to preserve that newer change. These local results do not verify that newer head. The local commit remains on branch `fix-2911`.

Please re-review the current PR head with its author's recorded evidence.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects solid parity, stock simulation, and the hidden-rest check that blocks posting.

The earlier finding is met. The PR body now records the motion and app heavy lanes on this head. The author reports 220 steps with no unexpected failures. Motion had 56 test passes. App had 42 test passes. The three declared #1950 tests failed as expected. I did not repeat the full heavy lanes.

The convex-cap correction retains the gouge and refused-plunge checks. The new tests retain the refusal for a pass that stops inside the neck. No goldens moved. No UI files changed.

Results locally, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `d5621be06134778fafc904da5395f6d3fbbf9b8b`:

- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=8 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 7 steps, 0 failed.
- Sim unit tests: 195 passed.
- `hidden_rest_banded`: 5 passed, 1 ignored.
- `scan_arc`: 2 passed.
- `turned_hidden_rest`: 6 passed.
- App `turning_hidden_floor`: 7 passed.
- Motion `finish3d` built successfully.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo test --release -j 8 -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d overhang_entries_are_refused_without_false_hidden_rest -- --ignored --exact`: PASS, 1 test.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-sim --test stock_sdf --test stock_columns --test field_floor --test stock_sim`: PASS. The suites passed 9, 3, 12, and 24 tests, respectively.
- The true hidden-rest control, `hidden_rest_surfaces_under_a_ceiling`, passed in `stock_sim`.
- The diff changes no fixture, golden, or importer file. The extra fixture and importer rules select no additional suites.

Mutations repeated by the reviewer on `thread_valleys_and_neck_step_at_window_edge_are_not_false_rest`:

1. Restore `solid_rest.rs` from upstream/main: RED, `rest 0.8218199909993696 > gate 0.05625`. Restore the PR file: GREEN.
2. Restore `scan_turned.rs` and `scan_hidden.rs` from upstream/main: RED, `rest 2.373499756758999 > gate 0.05625`. Restore the PR files: GREEN.

The restored worktree matches the trial-merged source. These mutations made no changes to the PR branch.

Requested before merge: none.

The GUI and the full release gate did not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
